purpose: Adapters for strict nineteenth-century nodes recovered through deep high-recall web discovery and then verified against institutional or authoritative sources.
guards: Search-engine discovery never promotes a record by itself; retain only the verified institutional or authoritative source URL.
A present-day total for a mixed historical collection is not a nineteenth-century slide count; isolate dated subsets downstream.
Preserve object, cabinet, catalogue, donation, damage, publication and later custody events as separate claims.

adapters.institution_scope: Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh Museum
adapters.target: official museum-history PDF and cited committee-record chronology
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture cupboard purchase and dated institutional microscopy decisions as collection-formation events; do not invent glass-slide counts where the history says only microscopical preparations.

adapters.institution_scope: Museum fuer Naturkunde Berlin Embryology Collection
adapters.target: official embryology collection page and historical catalogue context
adapters.promotion_rule: Model Hubrecht as the nineteenth-century founding subcollection and treat the present 80,000-preparation total as a mixed later aggregate until catalogue-level dates isolate historical series.

adapters.institution_scope: Ohio History Connection Natural History Museum Collections
adapters.target: official curator-authored Sullivant microscope-slide cabinet story
adapters.promotion_rule: Extract cabinet/drawer structure, named commercial preparers, Sullivant association and descendants' 1928 donation separately; keep maker attribution based on wrappers/labels auditable.

adapters.institution_scope: Manchester Museum Sydney Chaffers diatom collection
adapters.target: peer-reviewed collection-history article establishing current museum custody and six-cabinet structure
adapters.promotion_rule: Use the article to establish collection formation and cabinet structure; isolate individual 1895-1899 slides before calculating a nineteenth-century item total.
